read.title: Brand Guide for Creator Partners
read.text:
Thank you for working with Lumiere Skin. Please refer to this guide when you create content for us.

Keep our look consistent: use natural light and soft pink or white backgrounds. Make sure our logo is visible in the first three seconds of every video.

Please tag @lumiereskin and use #LumiereGlow in every post.

Medical claims such as "cures acne" or "removes wrinkles" are prohibited. Instead, talk about how the product feels and how your skin looks after using it.

write.en: Write an email sending the brand guide to a new influencer and reminding them about hashtags and prohibited claims.
write.model:
Hi Emma,

We're excited to work with you! I've attached our brand guide. Please refer to it for colors and logo placement. Make sure you include #LumiereGlow in your post. Also, medical claims like "cures acne" are prohibited.

Best,
Minsu
